paragraphs.text: Amrou Haven (AM-roo ) was the homeland of the kithkin on Dominaria . It lay on the western part of Jamuraa northwest of Arboria by the Storm Coast .
Amrou means "the people" . Once a paradise, Amrou was destroyed in the apocalypse and the kithkin were scattered across the salt steppes and the Maumiwu Wastes of Dominaria during the Rift Era.

Some kithkin, rebelling against their harsh living conditions, sought to reclaim Amrou, hoping to see vision of its past in the storms that quickly passed. The scouts still maintain beacons which signify "return" and "home".
